In this video we cover:
India’s Cement Battle: UltraTech, Ambuja & Shree Cement’s Big Expansion Plans
In just three years, the Adani and Birla Groups have added 90 million tonnes of cement capacity — more than Shree Cement’s total output. With UltraTech and Ambuja expanding fast, they could soon control over half of India’s cement capacity.
We’ll explore how India’s top cement players — UltraTech, Ambuja, and Shree Cement — are growing through premiumisation, cost efficiency, and green energy, and what this means for the future of India’s construction industry.
